cast.characterName: テオドール・エーベルバッハ
cast.originalCharacterName: テオドール・エーベルバッハ

segments.text: A surface pilot of the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken. Theodor fights purely for his own survival, rejecting everything else that might leave himself vulnerable, from his comrades in the 666th, and trusts no one around him. Though much younger than other members of the 666th, Theodor's skills are up there with the best, specializing in close combat he learned through knife self-defense.

After being captured by the Stasi in a failed attempt to defect to West Germany with them, he was tortured and his family was killed, giving him a deep hatred for the Stasi and anyone involved with them.

cast.characterName: カティア・ヴァルトハイム
cast.originalCharacterName: カティア・ヴァルトハイム

segments.text: Originally a member of the West German army, Katia was rescued by the 666th TSF Squadron after the rest of her unit was destroyed. She later applied for refugee/defection status, but was instead transferred to the 666th as a replacement pilot, at the recommendation its members. This odd occurrence has initially drew the suspicion of Theodor and the Stasi.
Though she has little experience as a TSF pilot, she possesses natural talent and instinct, which are things that cannot be taught, which is why people view her as a potential ace pilot.

cast.characterName: アイリスディーナ・ベルンハルト
cast.originalCharacterName: アイリスディーナ・ベルンハルト

segments.text: Captain Irisdina Bernhard is one of the main heroines of Schwarzesmarken and a secondary heroine in Bernhard im Schatten. Commander of the ‘East Germany’s Strongest’, the 666th TSF Squadron Schwarzesmarken, and Jürgen Bernhard's younger sister. Her command and development of the 666th make her one of the few capable of carrying out Laserjagd, typically considered "suicide" missions in strategic doctrine.

cast.characterName: リィズ・ホーエンシュタイン
cast.originalCharacterName: リィズ・ホーエンシュタイン

segments.text: Theodor Eberbach's adoptive sister. Lise Hohenstein was thought to have been killed by the Stasi 3 years ago when their family attempted to defect to West Germany and were all captured or killed. Lise Hohenstein grew up with parents and playwrights Thomas and Marlene in Prenzlauer Berg, Berlin. Like those two, Lise wanted to work in theater to bring smiles and dreams to people in a world she considered dark.

cast.characterName: アネット・ホーゼンフェルト
cast.originalCharacterName: アネット・ホーゼンフェルト

segments.text: Anett is a member of the 666th TSF Squadron and one of the few melee halberd users in the NVA, giving her a reputation as an abnormal pilot wherever she fights. She has a habit of screaming to shake off the fear of death before battle and suffers from PTSD.

cast.characterName: グレーテル・イェッケルン
cast.originalCharacterName: グレーテル・イェッケルン

segments.text: The political commissar attached to the 666th unit, tasked with reflecting the will of the Socialist Unity Party and assuring allegiance. The prideful Gretel is the most inexperienced TSF pilot in the 666th, but has the highest authority in the unit.

Gretel is a sincere socialist, having full pride in it as the ideology which eliminates the gap between rich and poor and considers everyone equally, and pride in East Germany as the nation which embodies the ideals of socialism.

cast.characterName: ファム・ティ・ラン
cast.originalCharacterName: ファム・ティ・ラン

segments.text: Pham Thi-Lan is the second-in-command of the 666th, being described as the spiritual backbone to the unit. Pham is called "Big Sis" by many of the younger surface pilots in the unit.

She is a second generation Vietnamese immigrant born in Lichtenberg, a suburb of East Berlin. She is the eldest of five siblings, 10 years older than the next. Being of Vietnamese descent, Pham experienced discrimination growing up in Berlin during wartime.
